messages:
Olivia: Heading to Austin next week for a client visit — any go-to breakfast tacos / quick coffee spots near the Austin office? Also flying to London in April, looking for casual dinner spots (ramen, small plates) around Shoreditch/Old St. Vegan-friendly recs welcome! :wave:
Dan: Torchy's is the tourist classic but for actually good tacos + coffee, try Veracruz All Natural (they do great migas tacos). For a chill sit-down breakfast, Paperboy is amazing but gets busy. :taco::coffee:
Sasha: If you want something quick and local-ish, Taco More has a walkable window. For vegan tacos, Arlo's (food truck) is 🔥. For coffee, Fleet Coffee has excellent pour-overs and pastries.
Chao: Austin evening rec if you have time — Odd Duck has small plates and good local beer. Not far from downtown. For barbecue, if you can spare a long line, Franklin is legendary but plan an afternoon.
Olivia: Oof Franklin line sounds brutal but noted. Any recs for a one-person dinner that isn't loud?
Maria: For a quieter spot, try Foreign & Domestic — neighborhood vibe, good for solo dining and a beer. Also Veracruz on 2nd has indoor seating.
Dan: London part — Dishoom (Covent Garden) is reliably good for small plates; not Shoreditch math but worth it. For ramen near Shoreditch, try Shoryu or Bone Daddies.
Sasha: Bao Borough is great for quick steamed buns, check the wait times. Flat Iron is good for a casual steak with friendly prices. For market vibes, Old Spitalfields / Boxpark have lots of little stalls if you want variety.
Chao: Vegan in London: 222 Veggie Vegan (Clapham-ish) is a bit out but great. Near Shoreditch, Try Comptoir Veggie stalls at markets or Vx (vegan ramen pop-up) — depends on the day.
Olivia: Awesome, thank you all! Quick poll — who wants to meet for tacos on Tues lunch when I'm in?
Maria: I'm in for Tues lunch, count me. :raised_hand:
Dan: Might be remote that day but vote yes if I'm in office.
Sasha: If my meeting finishes early I'll join.
calendar-bot: Created event "Austin tacos w/ Olivia" Tuesday 12:15pm — invite sent to Olivia, Maria, Sasha.
Olivia: Thanks — I'll DM the office address and walkable options. Appreciate the recs! :smile:
